title: Chats
summary: Each conversation is a chat of its own, kept to come back to.

requirements.text: Each conversation is a chat of its own, and the agent sees only the messages of the chat it answers in.
The chats are listed by when each was last used, newest first, each with its title and that time.
A new chat can be started from the list of chats and from an open chat.
A chat is titled by the model after its first answer, and the user can rename it.
A chat that is opened again shows all of it, with its queries and changes, and continues where it left off.
A chat can be deleted, once the user confirms it.
Chats are kept in the app's database, with every message, tool call and result, and which model wrote each answer.
A chat that has grown too long for the chosen model says so, and offers to start a new one.
The chats can be searched by their titles and messages.
